items.title: Add grill.json, clusters.json, scope-extension-decisions.json to LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES and remove the stale cluster.json entry
items.context: packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-registry.ts ~line 590-608 (the closed filename set). store.ts writes all three via writeJson(storyId, file) -> join(storyDir, file), so they are top-level story-dir files. Singular cluster.json is written nowhere (rg confirms the registry entry is the only occurrence) and has zero on-disk instances, vs 4 clusters.json and 1 grill.json under .lattice/story/actives — remove it in the same change.
items.userSees: rg 'grill.json|clusters.json|scope-extension-decisions.json|cluster.json' packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-registry.ts shows the three new entries present and the singular cluster.json entry gone

happy.desc: Under an enforce contract that lists no story-metadata paths, .lattice/story/actives/<id>/grill.json, clusters.json, and scope-extension-decisions.json classify as scope.lifecycle_artifact pass rows

edge.desc: The registry closed set no longer contains the singular cluster.json entry: rg over lifecycle-registry.ts shows the three new entries and no singular entry

adversarial.desc: A hand-created singular cluster.json at the story-dir top level (which no command writes) classifies fail-closed as rule=out_of_scope under enforce, preserving the narrow trust policy

verificationEvidence.note: The B-3ed9 commandFamilyArtifacts block asserts per-row scope.lifecycle_artifact:B-scope:{grill.json,clusters.json,scope-extension-decisions.json} pass rows under the enforce waveContract; smoke printed: scope contract smoke passed.
rg shows the three new entries at lines 625-627 and no singular cluster.json entry remains in the closed set.
The staleClusterNegative block asserts a hand-created .lattice/story/actives/B-scope/cluster.json classifies fail-closed rule=out_of_scope with blocking=true under the enforce waveContract.

items.title: Extend scope-contract-smoke.ts to cover the three new filenames and the removed stale entry
items.context: Follow the B-12a1 proofStoryArtifacts block in packages/main/src/tasks/scope-contract-smoke.ts (per-row assertions before aggregate status, per B-12a1 F-001): assert scope.lifecycle_artifact pass rows for .lattice/story/actives/B-scope/{grill.json,clusters.json,scope-extension-decisions.json} under the enforce waveContract, and assert that singular cluster.json (now unregistered) fails closed as rule=out_of_scope.
items.userSees: Running the scope contract smoke prints 'scope contract smoke passed'

happy.desc: The scope-contract smoke prints scope contract smoke passed with the new per-row assertions in place

edge.desc: Per-row assertions for the three new filenames run before the aggregate status check so a single-filename regression names the exact artifact (B-12a1 F-001 pattern)

adversarial.desc: Bite test: temporarily removing grill.json from the registry set makes the extended smoke fail naming grill.json, then restore and re-run to green — proves the new assertions are load-bearing

verificationEvidence.note: Full smoke run after the extension printed: scope contract smoke passed.

The per-row assertScopeRow loop for the three filenames precedes the aggregate commandFamilyPositive.status check in source order, matching the B-12a1 F-001 pattern so a regression names the exact artifact.

verificationEvidence.command: sed -i removal of grill.json from dist registry -> node packages/main/dist/tasks/scope-contract-smoke.js -> byte-restore -> re-run
verificationEvidence.note: Bite test transcript: with grill.json removed from the compiled registry the smoke failed with AssertionError naming B-3ed9 command-family lifecycle row grill.json (row classified out_of_scope); after byte-restore (cmp-verified) the smoke printed: scope contract smoke passed. Proves the new assertions are load-bearing. Run solo in this worktree to avoid dist bite-test races.
